status.notReady: WASM not loaded - cannot parse file.
status.ready: Ready - prewarmed {{workers}} worker(s), scales up to {{max}} on demand.
status.geometryWarning: Warning: Source machine {{source}} geometry differs from target machine {{target}} ({{extension}}). Export continues without layer resampling. Source is {{sourceResolution}} at {{sourceSize}} mm; target profile is {{targetResolution}} at {{targetSize}} mm. UVTools may report non-square pixels or an incorrect image ratio, and the model may print with stretched proportions.
status.photonsKeepWarning: Warning: PhotonS export keeps the source layer pixels but rewrites the bed size from {{sourceSize}} mm to {{targetSize}} mm. UVTools may report a changed image ratio.
status.photonsResampleWarning: Warning: PhotonS export resamples layers from {{sourceResolution}} to {{targetResolution}} and rewrites the bed size to {{targetSize}} mm. Source bed is {{sourceSize}} mm. Nearest-neighbor resampling can change edges and printed proportions.

onboarding.invitation: Take a quick tour of opening files, viewing layers and choosing an export format. You can replay it any time from the help button.

source.title: Open your slicer file
source.description: Drag a slicer file here or click to browse. After opening a file, this panel shows its format, dimensions, layer count and thumbnail.

preview.title: Inspect the layers
preview.description: Use the wheel to zoom and drag to pan. The toolbar fits the image, shows native pixels and toggles the pixel grid.

previewEmpty.description: Your exposure layers appear here after you open a slicer file. Use the wheel to zoom and drag to pan; the toolbar offers fit, native pixels and a pixel grid.

layer.title: Jump to a layer
layer.description: Drag the vertical slider or enter a layer number from 1 to the total and press Enter. The arrows step one layer at a time; the mm value shows the Z height.

export.title: Choose an export format
export.description: Choose the target format, extension and version supported by your printer. Review any geometry warnings before converting.

exportEmpty.description: Open a file to reveal the target format, extension, version and output name. Choose settings that match your printer and review any geometry warnings.

convert.title: Convert and save
convert.description: Check the output file name, then click Convert to save the result. Progress appears here; you can cancel a running conversion.

preferences.title: Make it yours
preferences.description: Switch between light and dark themes or English and Chinese. Your choices are remembered. Reopen this tour any time using the help button.

feedback.title: Report issues and share ideas
feedback.description: Use Report a bug to describe a problem, including the file format, steps to reproduce and screenshots. Use Request a feature to suggest improvements. Both open a GitHub issue form in a new tab; submitting feedback requires a GitHub account. The GitHub link opens the project repository.
